"lojbo karni" (LK) was a newsletter published by [[The Logical Language Group|The Logical Language Group]] from 1989-1994. It was first published in February 1989, as issue number 8, and contained the "news and product announcement section" of the March 1989 issue of "[[ju'i lobypli]]", also numbered 8.

For the first four issues of "lojbo karni", all dated 1989, publication preceded the publication of the corresponding issue of "ju'i lobypli". Subscribers of "ju'i lobypli" also received "lojbo karni". Beginning with "lojbo karni"/[[me lu ju'i lobypli li'u 12 moi|"ju'i lobypli" number 12]] (May 1990), "ju'i lobypli" reintegrated the news and announcements sections, so that it was no longer necessary for subscribers to "ju'i lobypli" to also receive "lojbo karni".

The last published version of "lojbo karni", numbered 18/19, appeared May 1994, one year after "ju'i lobypli" number 18. It was numbered 18/19 in anticipation of "ju'i lobypli" number 19 being published before additional news accumulated. However, that issue was never published.

==Issues==
* [[lojbo karni number 8]] - February 1989 (see also: [[me lu ju'i lobypli li'u 8 moi|ju'i lobypli number 8]], March 1989)
* [[lojbo karni number 9]] - May 1989 (see also: [[me lu ju'i lobypli li'u 9 moi|ju'i lobypli number 9]], June-July 1989)
* [[lojbo karni number 10]] - August 1989 (see also: [[me lu ju'i lobypli li'u 10 moi|ju'i lobypli number 10]], November-December 1989)
* [[lojbo karni number 11]] - November-December 1989 (see also: [[me lu ju'i lobypli li'u 11 moi|ju'i lobypli number 11]], March 1990)
* [[lojbo karni number 18/19]] - May 1994 (see also: [[me lu ju'i lobypli li'u 18 moi|ju'i lobypli number 18]], May-June 1993)
